newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean prosecutor won't summon Castro -sources.
newsitem.headline: Chilean prosecutor won't summon Castro -sources.

text.p: A military prosecutor has rejected a request by two Chilean lawmakers to call Cuban leader Fidel Castro to testify about illegal arms shipments when he visits Chile next week, court sources said Wednesday.

Military prosecutor Roberto Reveco rejected the request on the grounds that the two right-wing lawmakers, Senator Hernan Larrain and Deputy Andres Chadwick, are not plaintiffs in the case, the sources said.

Larrain and Chadwick had asked the prosecutor to summon Castro to court to testify about the 1986 seizure of an illegal arms cache on a beach in northern Chile. Many Chileans suspect Cuban involvement in the case.
Chilean government officials ridiculed the summons request as a ploy to put Castro on the spot before he arrives in Chile for an Ibero-American summit on November 9.
The prosecutor made the decision Tuesday, the sources said.
The leaders of 19 Latin American countries, Spain and Portugal will meet in Santiago and the coastal city of Vina del Mar for the Sixth Ibero-American Summit.
